title: Noun に 行きます
shortExplanation: Used to express going to a location.
longExplanation: The Noun に 行きます grammar point is used to express going to a specific location. This structure requires a noun (indicating the destination) followed by に and the verb 行きます, which means 'to go'.

examples.jp: 明日、スーパーに行きます。
examples.en: I will go to the supermarket tomorrow.

examples.jp: 週末に映画館に行きます。
examples.en: I will go to the movie theater on the weekend.

examples.jp: 夏休みに海に行きます。
examples.romaji: Natsu yasumi ni umi ni ikimasu.
examples.en: I will go to the sea during the summer vacation.
